summary.text: Hoan Huynh is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 13th District, based in Chicago.

paragraphs.text: According to the Illinois House Democrats biography, Huynh holds a B.A. in sociology from Yale University and a master's degree in policy from Harvard University.
Huynh previously was the investments and innovation lead at a Chicago social impact investments firm and is a refugee from Vietnam.
